events.verdict: Jakucionis (MIA) makes contact with the ball and with the part of Porter Jr.'s (MIL) hand that is on the ball.

Jaquez Jr. (MIA) and Porter Jr. (MIL) come together at the same spot and bump heads as they pursue the loose ball.  Contact to an opponent's head/face can be deemed marginal when the result of a natural basketball move, provided the contact is not disproportionate or uncontrolled.
Portis (MIL) initiates contact with Adebayo's (MIA) arm that affects his shot attempt.
Jakucionis (MIA) and Rollins (MIL) briefly engage and disengage off-ball.
Jakucionis (MIA) moves through Rollins' (MIL) space and drives him off his legally obtained position.
Sims (MIL) initiates contact with Adebayo (MIA) that impedes his pursuit of the rebound.
Rollins (MIL) establishes himself in Adebayo's (MIA) path prior to the contact.
Adebayo (MIA) is moving alongside Antetokounmpo's (MIL) path as he defends the shot attempt.
Portis (MIL) legally contests Jaquez Jr.'s (MIA) jump shot attempt.
Larsson (MIA) and Sims (MIL) briefly engage and disengage as they pursue the rebound.
Rollins (MIL) releases away from Larsson (MIA) to receive the pass.
Jakucionis (MIA) legally contests Portis' (MIL) jump shot attempt.
Adebayo's (MIA) right foot steps out of bounds as he returns to the floor.
Porter Jr. (MIL) commits a take foul on Adebayo (MIA).
